title: Fixed Internal Ring Planetary Display
description: One newly authored complete static planetary-layout display. A full vertical internally toothed annulus is grounded by two broad roots on a single bed. One central external-tooth sun and three separate external-tooth wheels occupy the same plane inside that ring. Every gear has continuous integral tooth flanks and a real axial bore. A complete rear three-arm carrier fixes the three offset pins; whole front retainers and rear spacers support each wheel. A central coaxial shaft and a separate grounded bored rear pedestal complete the apparatus. The new internal-tooth enclosure and common-axis carrier with parallel offset planet axes differ from the old two fixed parallel spur shafts, perpendicular worm/wheel or transverse four-cone differential. All whole numeric geometry is new, not a count change or rearrangement of imported gear meshes. Three opaque constant PBR roles, closed editable components, metres, Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred bed. One whole model, zero scenes. Deliberate finite envelope gaps between sun, planets and ring teeth make this a fixed illustrative layout only, not a meshed functioning epicyclic transmission. No involute accuracy, orbit, rotation, gear ratio, torque, bearing fit, power, lubrication, manufacture, load or equipment safety claim.
